patch_description: This replaces the fixed cube-entangling circuit with a permutation-equivariant alternating-operator ansatz. The data-dependent IsingZZ feature map already supplies graph interactions, so each variational block focuses on collective noncommuting rotations that transform encoded phases into measurable populations. Parameter sharing across all qubits matches the symmetric mean-Z readout, suppresses overfitting, and reinforces gradients. The circuit uses only three parameters per block—20 total including readout—and removes 120 fixed gates from the complete circuit, improving parameter efficiency and expected convergence.
